````text
# #3936: Patch: the AI's mulligan counts a Tribute card's units, so it stops keeping opening hands it cannot play
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

When the practice AI picks which opening cards to keep, it looks only at their mana cost. A card that also needs two or three of its own units sacrificed looks cheap, so the AI keeps it and throws back cards it could actually play. Holding Blue-Eyes White Felinor (1 mana, sacrifice 2 units), Lava Golem (3 mana, sacrifice 3) and Trigor (3 mana, sacrifice 3), the AI keeps all three, and none of them can be played until it has built a board. Its check that a hand has an early play is also satisfied by the 1-mana Felinor, which is no early play at all. Once this is built, the AI treats such a card as dearer the more units it needs, so the hands it keeps are hands it can start playing. Players notice a stronger opening from the AI in every game where it is dealt a Tribute card, which Stinkyscape+ has many of.

## Why

- `crates/ai/src/mulligan.rs:22,55,96,107,121`: every keep rule reads `query_cost(def)`, the mana cost alone (`crates/engine/src/catalog.rs:544`). That includes the bound, the one-drop cap and the early-play check.
- §6.3 Tribute X (`spec/06-keywords.md`): playing the card also sacrifices X of your units. The engine already offers the number, following Nerfs, Buffs and Floats: `jackioh_engine::play_choices::tribute_cost_of` (`crates/engine/src/play_choices.rs:821`).
- The catalog holds 37 non-token Tribute cards, and 16 of them cost 3 or less and so pass the bound (`AI_MULLIGAN.keep_max_cost` 3, `crates/ai/src/config.rs:999`). They include Blue-Eyes White Felinor (1, Tribute 2), Windfast (1, T1), Raven (0, T1), Lava Golem and Trigor (3, T3), and Stinkyscape+'s Tribute line: Fortress, Zenith, Scepter, Antumbra, Quad, Sei and Vela.
- The shadow ban is empty (`crates/ai/src/shadow_ban.rs:58`), so every one of them reaches the AI's decks, and Stinkyscape+'s fullsend deals the AI the whole set.

## Proposal

- In the AI's own keep (`mulligan_keep_curved` and the `mulligan_keep_shaped` it calls), read a card's mulligan cost as the larger of its mana cost and its Tribute plus a named per-unit allowance in `crates/ai/src/config.rs` (for example Tribute + 1).
- Then a Tribute 3 three-drop falls past the bound, and a 1-mana Tribute 2 card counts neither as a one-drop nor as the early play.
- Leave `mulligan_keep` itself alone: the frozen greedy baseline calls it (`crates/ai/src/baselines.rs:35`) and must not move.
- It reads only the AI's own hand (CLAUDE.md, crates/ai: hidden cards never change a decision).
- Write the reading as a ruling in the issue's block beside R2977000's bound, and update the mulligan paragraph of `crates/ai/README.md`.

## Where it lands

- `crates/ai/src/mulligan.rs`, `crates/ai/src/config.rs`, `crates/ai/README.md`
- `crates/ai/tests/ai/decide.rs` (`mod the_mulligans_curve`, its `mulligan_with` helper at `:399`)
- SPEC §9.9 (the practice AI), through `spec/pending/<issue>.md`

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A test dealing meditative-025, core-055 and traininggrounds-025 beside cheap plain cards has the AI send back Lava Golem and Trigor and not count Felinor as its early play. It fails today.
- [ ] A Tribute card whose Tribute a Nerf or Floats brought to 0 is kept by its mana cost alone.
- [ ] The greedy baseline's mulligan is unchanged and its tests pass.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-ai` and `cargo jackioh gate` pass, and `cargo jackioh spec check` is green with the new ruling and its test.

## Size and risks

Small: one module, a constant, tests, a README line and a ruling. Difficulty hard (the AI). Low risk: only hands holding a Tribute card are kept differently, which may move pinned AI fixtures or gate games that deal one.

---

## Plan

_Written by `claude-7` (claude, `sonnet`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/43696448717)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

The practice AI's own mulligan (`mulligan_keep_curved` and the `mulligan_keep_shaped` it calls) prices a card by a new **mulligan cost**. That is the mana cost, or, when the card has Tribute X right now, the larger of the mana cost and X plus a named allowance of 1. The Tribute is read with `tribute_cost_of`, so Nerfs, Buffs and Floats count.

After the change:
- Lava Golem (core-055) and Trigor (traininggrounds-025) go back.
- Blue-Eyes White Felinor (meditative-025) is no one-drop and no early play.
- A Tribute card whose Tribute is 0 is priced by its mana cost alone.
- The greedy baseline's `mulligan_keep` does not move.
- The reading is a ruling, R3936000, with its tests, a `spec/pending/3936.md` paragraph, an edit to §9.9 and an edit to the AI README.

## Files to touch

|---|---|
| `crates/ai/src/config.rs` | `change`: add `pub const AI_MULLIGAN_TRIBUTE_ALLOWANCE: i32 = 1;` after `AI_MULLIGAN_CURVE`. |
| `crates/ai/src/mulligan.rs` | `change`: add `mulligan_cost` and a private `keep_within`. `mulligan_keep_shaped` and `mulligan_keep_curved` read `mulligan_cost`. `mulligan_keep` stays unchanged in behaviour. Update the module header. |
| `crates/ai/tests/ai/decide.rs` | `change`: new `r3936000_…` tests inside `mod the_mulligans_curve` (after the last R2977000 test). |
| `crates/ai/README.md` | `change`: the mulligan paragraph (about lines 65–72) and the constants list (line 28). |

- `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`.
- `crates/engine`, `crates/cards`, `crates/tools` and the web app.
- `spec/11-rulings.md` and `spec/INDEX.md`. Never run `cargo jackioh spec index`.
- `crates/ai/src/baselines.rs`, `skill.rs` and `GREEDY_MULLIGAN`. They stay frozen.

Governing text: §9.9, §6.3, CLAUDE.md rules 3, 4 and 9, R2977000 (the bound), R386 (Nerf), R1841003 (Float).

## Steps

1. **`crates/ai/src/config.rs`.** After `AI_MULLIGAN_CURVE` add:
   ```rust
   /// R3936000: what a Tribute card's units add to its mulligan cost: a card that needs X units
   /// sacrificed first plays on the turn after the board is built, so its mulligan cost is at least X + this.
   pub const AI_MULLIGAN_TRIBUTE_ALLOWANCE: i32 = 1;
   ```
   Do not add a field to `AiMulligan`. `GREEDY_MULLIGAN` shares that struct and must stay frozen. `lib.rs` already re-exports `config::*`.

2. **`crates/ai/src/mulligan.rs`, imports.** Change the engine import to `use jackioh_engine::{CardDef, CardInstance, GameState, PlayerId, find_def, handicap_of, query_cost, tribute_cost_of};`. Add `AI_MULLIGAN_TRIBUTE_ALLOWANCE` to the `crate::config` import.

3. **New `pub fn mulligan_cost(state: &GameState, card: &CardInstance, def: &CardDef) -> i32`.** Give it a doc comment citing R3936000 and §6.3. The body:
   ```rust
   let cost = query_cost(def);
   let tribute = tribute_cost_of(state, card);
   if tribute <= 0 {
       return cost;
   }
   cost.max(tribute.saturating_add(AI_MULLIGAN_TRIBUTE_ALLOWANCE))
   ```
   It reads only the seat's own hand card. `decide` already passes a `redact`ed state, which keeps the seat's own hand whole.

4. **New private helper `fn keep_within(state, seat, keep_max_cost, cost_of: impl Fn(&CardInstance, &CardDef) -> i32) -> Vec<String>`.** It holds the existing loop: for each hand card with a def, push the id when `cost_of(card, def) <= keep_max_cost`.
   - `mulligan_keep` becomes `keep_within(state, seat, keep_max_cost, |_, def| query_cost(def))`. Its signature and output do not change.
   - `mulligan_keep_shaped` starts with `keep_within(state, seat, keep_max_cost, |card, def| mulligan_cost(state, card, def))`.

5. **`mulligan_keep_shaped`, the exception loop.** Bind `let cost = query_cost(def);`. Keep reading the **printed** cost for the exception: `cost != keep_max_cost.saturating_add(1) || cost > mana_cap` still skips. Add a third skip condition: `|| mulligan_cost(state, card, def) > cost`. A card its Tribute made dearer never takes the exception.
   - Reason: Lava Golem's `shaped_weight` is 3.0. It is in `UNBANNED_PREFER`, so it is absent from `DEALT_Q`, giving 1.0 × 3, and that is at least `DEAL_MULLIGAN_KEEP` (2.0).
   - If the exception read the mulligan cost (4 = bound + 1), it would keep Lava Golem, which the acceptance sends back.
   - Update the doc comment to say this.

6. **`mulligan_keep_curved`, the `cheap` loop.** Replace `let cost = query_cost(def);` with `let cost = mulligan_cost(state, card, def);`. Everything after it (`cost <= keep_max_cost`, `first_turn_max_cost`, `early_max_cost`, the sort and the truncate) is unchanged, so the one-drop cap and the early-play check now read mulligan costs. The exception card is not in `cheap`, so it passes through unchanged.

7. **Module header of `mulligan.rs`.** Add one sentence: cards are priced by `mulligan_cost` (R3936000) except in the greedy `mulligan_keep`.

8. **`spec/rulings/R3936000.md`.** Front matter:
   - `id: R3936000`
   - `title:` "The AI's mulligan counts a Tribute card's units: its cost is the larger of its mana cost and its Tribute plus one (issue #3936)"
   - `cards: "§9.9, §6.3, R386, R1841003, R2977000, issue #3936"`
   - `proven_in:` `crates/ai/tests/ai/decide.rs`

   Body, with every ruling written as `[[R…]]` and every section as `[[§…]]`:
   - **Why:** the mulligan read mana cost alone, so Felinor (1 mana, Tribute 2), Lava Golem and Trigor (3 mana, Tribute 3) were all kept. The AI could play none of them before building a board, and Felinor satisfied the early-play check.
   - **The rule:**
     - A card's mulligan cost is its mana cost, or, when `tribute_cost_of` (Nerfs [[R386]], Floats [[R1841003]]) is above 0, the larger of that and the Tribute plus `AI_MULLIGAN_TRIBUTE_ALLOWANCE`.
     - The AI's keep, [[R2977000]]'s bound, the one-drop cap and the early-play check all read it.
     - The shaped exception still reads the printed cost, and skips a card whose Tribute made its mulligan cost dearer.
     - The greedy baseline's `mulligan_keep` reads mana alone.
     - It reads only the AI's own hand.
   - **Decisions and rejected alternatives:**
     - The allowance is 1: a Tribute X card plays on turn X + 1 at one unit a turn.
     - The bound, the early-play limit and the Coin still move with the seat's mana bonus ([[R2977000]], R244). So a Hard seat (bound 4) keeps Lava Golem, and the second seat's Coin makes Felinor (mulligan cost 3) an early play.
     - Rejected: a separate unraised threshold for the Tribute part, which carries two numbers per card.
     - Rejected: letting the exception read the mulligan cost, which would keep Lava Golem.
     - Rejected: a field on `AiMulligan`, which would move the frozen greedy constant.

9. **`spec/pending/3936.md`.** One paragraph, in the format of `spec/pending/3912.md`:
   `**[[R3936000]] The AI's mulligan counts a Tribute card's units (issue #3936, 2026-11-15)**: …`
   Cover what changed (the keep, the bound, the one-drop cap and the early check read the mulligan cost), the decisions above, and the rejected alternatives. End with `It takes R3936000, the first number of issue #3936's block, and edits [[§9.9]].`

10. **`spec/09-architecture.md` line 163.** After "…so Medium's and Hard's four-drops stay ([[R2977000]])," insert: "a card that needs units sacrificed (Tribute X) costs it the larger of its mana cost and X plus one, so a Tribute 3 three-drop goes back and a one-mana Tribute 2 card is neither a one-drop nor an early play ([[R3936000]]),". Change nothing else on that line.

11. **`crates/ai/README.md`.** In the mulligan paragraph, say a card's cost there is `mulligan_cost` (R3936000):
    - the mana cost, or the larger of that and its current Tribute plus `AI_MULLIGAN_TRIBUTE_ALLOWANCE`;
    - the shaped exception never takes a card its Tribute made dearer;
    - the greedy baseline's `mulligan_keep` reads mana alone.

    Add `AI_MULLIGAN_TRIBUTE_ALLOWANCE` to the constants list at line 28.

12. **Tests** (below), then run the commands.

## Tests

All in `crates/ai/tests/ai/decide.rs`, inside `mod the_mulligans_curve`, with these new constants:

```rust
const FELINOR: &str = "meditative-025"; // 1 mana, Tribute 2
const LAVA_GOLEM: &str = "core-055"; // 3 mana, Tribute 3, shaped weight 3.0
const TRIGOR: &str = "traininggrounds-025"; // 3 mana, Tribute 3
```

Add a helper `tribute_premises(state: &GameState, seat: PlayerId, at: usize, cost: i32, tribute: i32)`. It asserts `query_cost` and `tribute_cost_of` of the hand card at index `at`.

Add a helper `cost_at(state: &GameState, seat: PlayerId, at: usize) -> i32` that calls `mulligan_cost` for that hand card.

Add one more helper that asserts `shaped_weight(LAVA_GOLEM) >= DEAL_MULLIGAN_KEEP`, and `shaped_weight(TRIGOR)` and `shaped_weight(FELINOR)` are below it.

Imports to add:
- `mulligan_cost` and `AI_MULLIGAN_TRIBUTE_ALLOWANCE` from `jackioh_ai`.
- `tribute_cost_of` and `Tuning` from `jackioh_engine::testkit` (it re-exports `crate::*`).
- `jackioh_engine::float::TRIBUTE_LOWERED_KEY`.
- `indexmap::IndexMap`.

Build a Float with `card.memory.insert(TRIBUTE_LOWERED_KEY.to_string(), json!(n))`. Build a Nerf with `card.tuning = Some(Tuning { x: Some(IndexMap::from([("Tribute".to_string(), -1)])), ..Tuning::default() })`.

1. **`r3936000_the_issues_opening_sends_back_lava_golem_and_trigor`**
   - Hand: `seat_mulligan_with("decide-r3936000-opening", P1, &[FELINOR, LAVA_GOLEM, TRIGOR])`.
   - Asserts:
     - The premises hold.
     - `kept(&must_decide(..)) == hand_at(&state, P1, 0..1)`. Only Felinor stays, as the one digging card; today all three stay.
     - `act` accepts the answer.
     - `mulligan_keep(&state, P1, GREEDY_MULLIGAN.keep_max_cost)` still returns all three ids.

2. **`r3936000_a_one_mana_tribute_two_card_is_neither_a_one_drop_nor_the_early_play`**
   - P1 hand `[FELINOR, THREE, THREE]`:
     - `cost_at` of the first card is 3.
     - The decision keeps `AI_MULLIGAN_CURVE.keep_without_early` cards. Today it keeps all three, because Felinor counts as early.
   - P1 hand `[ONE, THREE, THREE]` keeps all three, as a control.

3. **`r3936000_tribute_cards_beside_cheap_plain_cards_go_back_by_their_mulligan_cost_and_the_exception_never_rescues_them`**
   - Hand: `hard_p2_mulligan_with("decide-r3936000-beside", &[FELINOR, LAVA_GOLEM, TRIGOR, ONE, TWO])`, then `on(&state, None)`.
   - Expected keep: `hand_at(&state, P2, [0, 3, 4])`, i.e. Felinor, ONE and TWO.
   - Also assert that `mulligan_keep_shaped` at `AI_MULLIGAN.keep_max_cost` keeps neither Lava Golem nor Trigor. This pins the exception guard, since Lava Golem's weight is 3.0.

4. **`r3936000_a_tribute_card_whose_tribute_a_nerf_or_floats_brought_to_zero_costs_its_mana_alone`**
   - P1 `[FELINOR, LAVA_GOLEM, TRIGOR]` with `tributeLowered` set to 2, 3 and 3.
     - `cost_at` is 1, 3, 3 (the mana costs).
     - The decision keeps all three. Felinor is a one-drop and an early play.
   - Felinor with a Float of 1 → mulligan cost 2.
   - Felinor with a Nerf of −1 → 2.
   - Felinor with both a Nerf of −1 and a Float of 1 → Tribute 0 → 1.
   - Lava Golem with a Nerf of −1 and a Float of 2 → Tribute 0 → 3.

5. **`r3936000_the_bound_a_mana_bonus_raises_applies_to_the_mulligan_cost_too`**
   - `hard_p2_mulligan_with(…, &[LAVA_GOLEM, LAVA_GOLEM, TRIGOR, ONE, TWO])` on Hard's handicap (bound 4) keeps all five.
   - The same hand on `on(&state, None)` (bound 3) keeps only `[3, 4]`.

Commands:
```
cargo test -p jackioh-ai r3936000
cargo test -p jackioh-ai
cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit --test 'rules*' r2977000
cargo fmt --check
cargo clippy -p jackioh-ai --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo jackioh spec check
cargo jackioh gate
cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims
```

## Done when

- [ ] `mulligan_cost` and `AI_MULLIGAN_TRIBUTE_ALLOWANCE` exist. The keep, the bound, the one-drop cap and the early check read the mulligan cost.
- [ ] A test with meditative-025, core-055 and traininggrounds-025 sends back Lava Golem and Trigor and does not count Felinor as early. It fails on `main`.
- [ ] A Tribute card brought to Tribute 0 by a Nerf or Floats is priced by mana alone (test 4).
- [ ] `mulligan_keep` and the greedy baseline are unchanged, and the existing greedy test (`b27_…`) passes.
- [ ] R3936000, `spec/pending/3936.md`, the §9.9 sentence and the README are written.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-ai` passes, and `cargo jackioh gate` passes (smoke).
- [ ] `cargo jackioh spec check` is green, and so are `cargo fmt --check` and clippy.
- [ ] No `#[allow]`, `#[ignore]` or lowered floor was added. The `classify --claims` result is reported (no catalog change, so no pending patch fragment is expected).

## Risks

- **Lava Golem's weight.** The exception would keep it if it read the mulligan cost. Step 5's guard and test 3 cover this. Do not "simplify" the exception to `mulligan_cost`.
- **Greedy baseline.** `mulligan_keep` is called by `baselines.rs` and `skill.rs`. Keep it on `query_cost` and keep its signature. Test 1 asserts it still returns all three cards.
- **Pinned AI fixtures and gate games.** Hands holding a Tribute card are now kept differently, so seeded AI tests or the gate smoke may move. Run `cargo test -p jackioh-ai` and `cargo jackioh gate`. Re-pin a seeded value only after confirming the hand holds a Tribute card, and say so in the report. If a gate floor goes red, report it by name. Do not edit `crates/tools` or lower a floor.
- **Hidden information.** `tribute_cost_of` reads the AI's own hand card on the `redact`ed state, whose own hand is whole. Do not read the opponent's cards or library.
- **Purity.** Use no new dependency. `tribute_cost_of` is an engine pure read, and there is no clock or I/O.
- **Wasm and web.** `AiMulligan` and `AiMulliganCurve` are untouched, so no generated wire file changes. Check `git status -- apps/web/src/wire` is clean after the workspace tests.

## Open questions

None block the build. For a person's later call: should a seat's mana bonus and the Coin raise the Tribute part of the bound and the early-play limit? The plan follows the issue, so they do. Hard keeps Lava Golem, and the second seat counts Felinor as early. R3936000 records this and the rejected alternative.
````
